welcome:proof-remote-connect: Desktop access waits for a paired iPhone host before the dashboard is opened.
welcome:proof-remote-pair: Pairing stays inside the offer and PIN flow. The host still controls the final unlock.
welcome:proof-remote-wait: Transport is ready, but the vault remains sealed until the iPhone host unlocks locally.
welcome:proof-unlock: Unlock happens on this device. Secrets stay sealed until the local vault is opened.
welcome:proof-create-master: The master password protects storage creation, backup, restore, and destructive operations.
welcome:proof-default: Choose whether this device stores data locally or waits for a paired host before the first unlock.
welcome:remote-hosts-desc: Choose a paired WSS/WebRTC host or pair a new network host before entering the dashboard.
welcome:no-paired-hosts-desc: This list only shows WSS/WebRTC remote hosts. USB-paired Android devices are available through USB below.
welcome:waiting-for-peer-desc: The transport is already connected. Open the vault directly on your iPhone to continue into the remote dashboard.
welcome:waiting-for-peer-hint: This desktop cannot unlock the host vault remotely. Access appears here automatically after the host opens it locally.
welcome:waiting-for-phone-approval-desc: The phone vault is open, but this desktop session still needs permission from the phone.
welcome:waiting-for-phone-approval-hint: Tap Allow on the phone to open the remote vault here. Disconnect cancels this request.
welcome:mode-remote-desc: Connect to a paired phone whose vault is already open
welcome:remote-vault-desc: Connect to a paired iPhone host before opening the vault on this desktop.
welcome:pair-iphone-hero-desc: Paste the pairing offer from your mobile host and confirm it with the displayed PIN.
welcome:wait-iphone-desc: Transport is ready. Open the vault on your iPhone to continue into the remote dashboard.
welcome:wait-phone-approval-desc: Approve this desktop on the phone to continue into the remote dashboard.
welcome:unlock-desc: Your device is locked. Enter your Vault Password to access data.
welcome:create-master-desc: Set up your master password to secure your storage.
welcome:choose-storage-desc: Welcome to ChromVoid. Choose how you want to store your data.
welcome:storage-created: Storage created! Now unlock your vault.
welcome:unlock-proof-suffix: until the local vault is opened.
welcome:remote-mode-unavailable: Remote mode is not available on this device
welcome:remote-pairing-done: Pairing completed. Select the iPhone host to connect.
welcome:remote-connected-wait: Transport connected. Waiting for the vault to be opened on your iPhone.
welcome:remote-connected-open: Transport connected. Open the vault on your iPhone to continue.
welcome:restore-stopping: Stopping restore. Waiting for current operation to finish safely.
welcome:restore-running: Restore is in progress. You can cancel it if needed.
welcome:device-utilities-meta: Backup, restore, and destructive maintenance live here.
welcome:device-utilities-note: Secondary actions stay collapsed by default so the primary unlock flow keeps focus.
welcome:backup-inline-desc: Create an encrypted backup from this device. The master password is verified locally before the backup starts.
welcome:restore-inline-desc: Restore replaces the local vault data on this device. Choose a backup source after confirming the operation.
welcome:restore-inline-confirm: I understand this restore will replace the current local device data.
welcome:restore-inline-confirm-required: Confirm that restore will replace current local device data.
welcome:change-password-inline-desc: Change the master password used to protect local backups. Existing backups still require the previous password.
welcome:erase-inline-desc: Erase permanently deletes all local vault data from this device. This cannot be undone.
welcome:erase-inline-confirm: I understand this permanently deletes all local data on this device.
welcome:erase-inline-confirm-required: Confirm that local device data will be permanently deleted.
welcome:catalog-repair-message: ChromVoid can repair the vault catalog and then open the vault. Older encrypted chunks will be preserved.
welcome:catalog-repair-message-with-seq: ChromVoid can repair the vault catalog by keeping changes through seq ${safeSeq} and skipping the failing change at seq ${seq} (${path}). Older encrypted chunks will be preserved.
welcome:remove-paired-host-message: Remove "${label}"? You will need to pair this ${target} again before reconnecting.
welcome:remote-transport-not-ready: Remote transport did not become ready.
remote-storage:page-subtitle: Manage mounted volumes and data backups
remote-storage:encrypted-export-text: Create a full storage copy protected by the master password. Use it for backups or data transfer.
remote-storage:volume-unavailable-platfo: Volume is not available on this platform
remote-storage:security-text: A mounted volume is a decrypted view of the data that other applications can see. Use it only in a trusted environment.
remote-storage:macfuse-optional-text: Without macFUSE, ChromVoid automatically uses WebDAV and requires no additional software. For faster local access, install the optional third-party macFUSE driver from its official website, then select Refresh.
remote-storage:macfuse-open-failed: Failed to open the macFUSE website
remote-storage:webdav-text: Use this URL to connect in Finder or Explorer:
remote-storage:webdav-step-macos: macOS Finder: press Cmd+K → paste the URL → Connect
remote-storage:webdav-step-windows: Windows Explorer: Add a network location → paste the URL
remote-storage:confirm-description: Specify the folder for storing the storage backup.
remote-storage:what-exported-text: A full encrypted storage copy with all vaults and files. The master password will be required for restore.
remote-storage:default-folder-info: If no folder is selected, the backup will be saved to the app’s default folder.
remote-storage:password-description: Enter the master password to create the backup.
remote-storage:remember-password-text: The same master password will be required to restore data from the backup. Make sure it is stored safely.
remote-storage:progress-description: Please do not close the application until completion.
remote-storage:progress-cancel-descripti: Cancellation requested. Wait for current operations to finish.
remote-storage:backup-running-text: Data is encrypted and written to disk. This may take several minutes depending on storage size.
remote-storage:backup-stopping-text: Waiting for the process to stop safely. This may take some time.
remote-storage:result-success-hint: The storage backup was created and saved to disk
remote-storage:result-cancelled-hint: The operation was stopped at the user’s request.
guidance:welcome.local-vs-remote:title: Choose where the vault lives
guidance:welcome.local-vs-remote:body: Use a local vault for this device or connect to a remote vault when another device already owns the storage.
guidance:welcome.master-password:title: Create a master password you can recover
guidance:welcome.master-password:body: This password protects the vault. Store the recovery materials before adding important data.
guidance:welcome.backup-restore:title: Keep a recovery path
guidance:welcome.backup-restore:body: Backups and restore tools let you move the vault safely before replacing or erasing a device.
guidance:welcome.erase-device-warning:bo: Erasing removes local vault data from this device. Make a backup or confirm another device has the current vault first.
guidance:files.empty-state:title: Add your first encrypted file
guidance:files.empty-state:body: Create a folder or upload files here. They stay inside the vault and are available after unlock.
guidance:notes.empty-state:title: Start a private note
guidance:notes.empty-state:body: Notes are saved in the encrypted vault, so you can keep recovery codes and reminders near related files.
guidance:passwords.empty-state:title: Save the first password
guidance:passwords.empty-state:body: Create an entry to keep credentials encrypted with the vault instead of storing them in the browser.
guidance:passwords.import-migration:body: Preview imported items first, resolve conflicts, and keep the browser or CSV provider unchanged until the vault copy looks right.
guidance:passkeys.empty-state:title: How passkeys get here
guidance:passkeys.empty-state:body: Keep the vault unlocked and confirm the request. ChromVoid saves the passkey in the vault, and it appears here automatically.
guidance:remote.setup-network:title: Pair over the network
guidance:remote.setup-network:body: Network pairing lets this dashboard unlock or manage a vault hosted on another trusted device.
guidance:gateway.pair-extension:title: Pair the browser extension
guidance:gateway.pair-extension:body: Start pairing here, then approve the extension so it can request vault actions through the desktop gateway.
guidance:pro.remote.blocked:title: Remote access is not available yet
guidance:pro.remote.blocked:body: This state can mean Pro is locked, entitlement data is unavailable, rollout is disabled, or the platform does not support the feature.
guidance:pro.gateway.blocked:title: Browser extension gateway is blocked
guidance:pro.gateway.blocked:body: Check whether the platform supports the gateway, the rollout is enabled, and Pro entitlement is available.
guidance:pro.remote-storage.blocked:body: Mounted vault actions require platform support and an enabled entitlement state before files are exposed to the OS.
guidance:pro.blocked.unsupported:body: This platform does not support the feature in the current runtime.
guidance:pro.blocked.disabled-by-rollout: The feature is temporarily disabled by rollout policy for this build or account.
guidance:pro.blocked.entitlement-unavail: ChromVoid could not read the active Core license state. Reconnect or refresh license data before retrying.
guidance:pro.blocked.locked-pro:body: Activate a Pro license in Settings to unlock this feature.
guidance:remote-storage.mount-warning:ti: Mount only while you need OS access
guidance:remote-storage.mount-warning:bo: A mounted vault is decrypted for the operating system and apps. Lock it again when external access is no longer needed.
guidance:settings.ssh-agent:title: Use vault keys with SSH
guidance:settings.ssh-agent:body: Enable the SSH agent when desktop apps should request keys without exporting private material.
guidance:settings.mobile-autofill:title: Enable mobile autofill
guidance:settings.mobile-autofill:body: Turn on the credential provider so Android or iOS can offer vault credentials in apps and browsers.
wallet:send:quote-stale: The fee quote expired. Refresh it before using Max.
wallet:send:no-recipients: No saved recipients for this network yet.
wallet:send:error:address-required: Enter or choose a recipient address.
wallet:send:error:amount-required: Enter an amount greater than zero.
wallet:send:error:max-unavailable: Refresh the fee quote before sending the maximum amount.
wallet:send:error:comment-too-long: The comment must be at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.
wallet:send:error:contact-label: Enter a name between 1 and 80 characters.
otp-import:local-description: Verification-code setup links can be imported only into the local vault on this Mac.
otp-import:website-warning: Optional. Without a website, the code is saved but may not appear as a contextual AutoFill suggestion.
otp-import:duplicate-title: A code with this label already exists
otp-import:duplicate-description: Choose an explicit action. ChromVoid never overwrites it automatically.
otp-import:duplicate-replace-description: Save the new code, then remove the old one.
otp-import:duplicate-rename-description: Keep both codes under different labels.
otp-import:error-target: Choose an existing login or create a new one.
otp-import:error-duplicate: Choose whether to replace the existing code or change this label.
otp-import:error-rename: Enter a different label before saving another code.
settings:provider-macos-multi-provider-n: Apple Passwords can stay enabled. Enable ChromVoid as an AutoFill source and choose it separately for setting up verification codes.
settings:provider-otp-unsupported-os: Verification-code AutoFill requires macOS 15 or newer
settings:provider-otp-vault-required: Unlock the vault to use verification-code AutoFill
settings:provider-otp-extension-disabled: Enable ChromVoid as an AutoFill source
settings:provider-otp-unverified: Verification-code AutoFill status could not be verified
settings:provider-setup-available: ChromVoid can handle verification-code setup links
settings:provider-setup-unverified: Verification-code setup handler could not be verified
